Name: Shemaiah, Son of Galal
Summary: Son of Galal son of Jeduthun, father of Obadiah the Levite.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:16: Son of Galal son of Jeduthun, father of Obadiah the Levite.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shemaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
